findings.description: The previous summarize() loaded one calibration per distinct sensor_id. The new loop calls calibrated(), which calls source.load() for every reading. With a SqlCalibrationSource this issues one database query per reading, so a batch of N readings costs N queries where it previously cost one per sensor. Large batches will be slow and put avoidable load on the database.
findings.suggestion: Restore the per-sensor cache: load calibrations for the distinct sensor_ids in the batch (materialise the iterable first), then apply each reading using the cached calibration, or memoise source.load within summarize().
findings.title: Calibration is loaded once per reading instead of once per sensor
